# MODEL: Two agents, 3 states (s0-s2), edges with costs and no actions.

# PURPOSE: The Kripke model of OL (ECAI 2023, Definition 2): each edge has one
# cost. Transition_With_Costs gives one cost per agent, summed into the edge cost.

# LOGIC: OL

# DESCRIPTION: s0 goes to s1 (cost 1:1, so 2) and to goal s2 (cost 1:0, so 1).
# Keeping every path from s0 in goal means disabling the edge to s1, which costs 2.

Transition_With_Costs
0 1:1 1:0
0 1:0 0
0 0 1:0

Name_State
s0 s1 s2
Initial_State
s0
Atomic_propositions
goal
Labelling
0
0
1
Number_of_agents
2
